concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-aib-af-overview]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted direct-link portal for recipients with at least one merchant account provisioned and funded by AIB, routing to account-tailored articles and preserving banking-partner variability; the page does not define AF, establish a region or pricing model, or document any linked target's behavior
warnings: Preserve the page's at-least-one-merchant-account condition; do not generalize AIB provisioning or funding to every account.
Treat AF as an undefined route label; do not infer region, pricing, or behavior of linked targets.
